_comment: Model registry. `python -m forge models pull <name>` downloads into models/<dest>. commercial_ok is read from the model's licence; shipped game assets come only from commercial_ok models (docs/LICENSING.md). Verify a licence yourself before you ship — this table is a convenience, not legal advice.

sdxl-base-1.0.notes: The baseline. Use-based restrictions apply (no illegal/harmful content) but commercial use of weights and outputs is permitted.

flux2-klein-4b.notes: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, ComfyUI repackage, fp8: the base model (20 steps, cfg 5 — takes LoRAs and negatives) and the distilled one (4 steps, cfg 1). Needs flux2-klein-text-encoder and flux2-vae. Graph: forge/engines/flux2_graph.py.

flux2-klein-9b.notes: Experiments only. Not for shipped assets.

qwen-image-edit-2509.notes: Reference-image editing (pose sheets with the Spritely LoRAs). ~20B params: fp8/GGUF + CPU offload on 16 GB VRAM.

flux2-klein-text-encoder.notes: Qwen3 4B text encoder for the klein 4B models (~8 GB).

flux2-vae.notes: The FLUX.2 VAE (shared by all FLUX.2 models; also at Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/split_files/vae/). Pulled from the klein-9B repo only because that repo is open; the 9B *model* is non-commercial and is not registered here.

flux1-schnell-fp8.notes: FLUX.1 [schnell] unet, fp8 (~12 GB). 4 steps. Needs flux1-text-encoders and flux1-vae. Runs William's FLUX.1 LoRAs (RPGmaps_v5, RPGv6, bbeam_comic). Graph: forge/engines/flux1_graph.py.

flux1-dev-fp8.notes: FLUX.1 [dev] unet, fp8 (~12 GB). 20 steps, guidance 3.5. Most Civitai FLUX fine-tunes and LoRAs are trained on dev and look best here — but the licence is non-commercial: experiments and comparisons only, never a shipped asset.

flux1-text-encoders.notes: CLIP-L and T5-XXL (fp8) for every FLUX.1 model and fine-tune.

flux1-vae.notes: The FLUX.1 VAE (identical for dev and schnell).

flux2-klein-9b-text-encoder.license: Apache-2.0 (Qwen3 8B encoder); the klein 9B MODEL it serves is FLUX Non-Commercial
flux2-klein-9b-text-encoder.notes: Only needed for the klein 9B base/distilled models (bake-off comparisons; those models cannot ship).

realesrgan-x4plus.notes: Real-ESRGAN x4plus (xinntao) — the forge's default upscaler (forge.json comfy.upscale_model). Official GitHub release weights; HF mirror in lllyasviel/Annotators. 4x-UltraSharp is deliberately NOT registered: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial).

controlnet-union-sdxl-promax.notes: SDXL ControlNet++ union (canny/lineart/mlsd, depth, normal, tile, openpose, scribble, segment) in one file, ~2.5 GB; ComfyUI picks the mode with SetUnionControlNetType. Saved under a unique name (the repo's file name is generic). Licence per the model card at registration time (Apache-2.0) — re-check the card before shipping.

face-yolov8m.notes: Face detector for FaceDetailer (Impact Pack + Subpack, install_comfy_faces.bat). It only finds faces — the repainting is done by the job's own checkpoint. ComfyUI lists it as bbox/face_yolov8m.pt.

depth-anything-v2-small.notes: Depth for the depth ControlNet, via comfyui_controlnet_aux (install_comfy_aux.bat), which downloads it itself on first use — no pull needed. Only the Small model: Depth Anything V2 Base/Large/Giant are CC-BY-NC-4.0 and the forge never asks for them.

midas-dpt-hybrid.notes: MiDaS depth (fallback when the Depth Anything V2 node is absent); downloaded by comfyui_controlnet_aux on first use.
